ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The original building above is composed of 5 small cubes: the lower layer is a compact low base, visually it can be regarded as a 2×2 footprint composed of 4 bottom-layer blocks; on one of the bottom-layer blocks another 1 block is stacked, forming one two-layer-high column. The A-E below are all candidate buildings of 5 cubes. A shows one three-layer column and a low block beside it; B and D show two adjacent two-layer positions on a low base; E shows a single two-layer position after being moved on a compact base; C instead shows the bottom layer spread out into a longer arrangement, while the position of the two-layer column also changes. Reasoning: If only 1 cube is moved, from the original building to a candidate building, it must be possible to keep 4 of the original 5 positions unmoved, only taking away the block at 1 original position and placing it at 1 new position. Comparing item by item: A can be regarded as moving one non-load-bearing bottom-layer block in the original base to the top of the original two-layer column, with the remaining 4 blocks kept; B can be regarded as moving one bottom-layer corner block onto an adjacent bottom-layer block, forming a second two-layer column; D is similar to B, being a single-block upward move on the other side/symmetric position; E can also, by moving one block in the original building to the corresponding empty position in the figure, make the other 4 blocks correspond to the original building. C cannot: to obtain C, one must both change the original compact bottom-layer base into the more spread-out bottom arrangement in the figure, and also make the high block change to the corresponding position relative to the base; this involves changes in at least two original block positions, and cannot be done by moving only 1 block. Therefore the one that cannot be obtained from the original building by moving only one cube is C.

raw_record.question_text: Among the labeled buildings A-E, which building cannot be obtained from the building on the right by moving only one cube?

method.method_draft: 先看图：右边原建筑是 5 个小立方体组成的，外形是一个低底座上带一处更高的堆叠。再看选项 A-E，把每个选项都当成“从原建筑拿走 1 个立方体，再放到别的位置”的结果来检查，要求剩下的 4 个立方体位置不变，只允许一个起点和一个终点发生变化。逐个比对时，A、B、D、E 都能对应到这种单块平移；只有 C 需要同时改动底部排布和高处位置，不能只靠移动 1 块得到，所以答案是 C。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：上方原建筑由5个小立方体组成：下层是一个紧凑的低底座，视觉上可看成4个底层方块组成的2×2脚印；其中一个底层方块上又叠了1块，形成一处两层高的柱。下方A-E都是5块立方体的候选建筑。A显示一处三层柱及旁边低块；B、D显示低底座上有两个相邻的二层位置；E显示紧凑底座上移动后的单个二层位置；C则显示底层摊开成更长的排布，同时二层柱的位置也改变。
推理：若只移动1个立方体，从原建筑到候选建筑时，必须能保留原来5个位置中的4个不动，只把1个原位置的方块拿走并放到1个新位置。逐项比对：A可视为把原底座中一个不承重的底层块移到原二层柱顶上，剩余4块保持；B可视为把一个底层角块移到相邻底层块上，形成第二个二层柱；D与B类似，是另一侧/对称位置的单块上移；E也能通过把原建筑中的一个方块移到图中相应的空位，使其余4块与原建筑对应。C不行：要得到C，既要把原来的紧凑底层底座改成图中更展开的底部排布，又要使高处方块相对底座换到相应位置；这至少牵涉两个原方块位置的变化，无法做到只移动1块。因此不能由原建筑只移动一个立方体得到的是C。

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的形状特征：原建筑和每个选项都可抽象成若干“列高”组成的轮廓。接着把题意翻成规则：一次只动 1 块，意味着只能把一列高度减 1、另一列高度加 1，轮廓变化必须是局部的。于是只需比较源图与各选项的高度分布是否能通过这种局部调整得到；A、B、D、E 都像是把一块从某个位置挪到相邻/另一列后的结果，而 C 的底部横向排布和高柱位置同时发生了不止一处改变，超出了一次移动能造成的轮廓变化，因此 C 不能由右图移动 1 块得到。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：上方原建筑由5块小立方体组成，可看成若干列高的组合：底层有4块形成紧凑的平面排布，其中一个位置上再叠1块，形成一根高度为2的柱，其余位置高度为1。下方A-E也都是5块：A表现为一根3层高柱加旁边低块；B、E像是在原有底层附近把叠高位置换到另一列；D像是形成两根2层柱；C则底部横向排布被拉开，同时高柱位置也与原图不对应。推理：只移动1块，等价于从某一列减去1块、在另一列加上1块，因此整体轮廓只能在一个取走位置和一个放置位置发生变化，其他4块应保持可对应。A可看成把一个底层单块搬到原高柱顶上；B、E可看成把原高柱顶块搬到另一底层柱上；D可看成把一个底层单块搬到另一单块上，形成两根2层柱。C不仅需要改变底部横向排布，还需要改变高柱的支撑位置，涉及不止一处结构变化，不可能只移动1块得到。因此不能得到的是C。

Comparing item by item: A can be regarded as moving one non-load-bearing bottom-layer block in the original base to the top of the original two-layer column, with the remaining 4 blocks kept; B can be regarded as moving one bottom-layer corner block onto an adjacent bottom-layer block, forming a second two-layer column; D is similar to B, being a single-block upward move on the other side/symmetric position; E can also, by moving one block in the original building to the corresponding empty position in the figure, make the other 4 blocks correspond to the original building. C cannot: to obtain C, one must both change the original compact bottom-layer base into the more spread-out bottom arrangement in the figure, and also make the high block change to the corresponding position relative to the base; this involves changes in at least two original block positions, and cannot be done by moving only 1 block. Therefore the one that cannot be obtained from the original building by moving only one cube is C.
